name: RC-B10-0069/2025 – After § 7 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text: 7b. Calls for the EU to suspend its Memorandum of Understanding with Rwanda on sustainable raw materials, and to suspend all military cooperation with Rwanda, including through the European Peace Facility or any other mechanism, until Rwanda ends its illegal support of armed groups and fully respects the sovereignty and territorial integrity of the DRC;
